newsitem.title: LATVIA: VENTSPILS, LASAM TO BE SOLD IN FOUR STAGES.
newsitem.headline: VENTSPILS, LASAM TO BE SOLD IN FOUR STAGES.

text.p: Oil terminal Ventspils Nafta and pipeline operator Lasam will be sold in four stages, according to rules for their privatisation drawn up by the privatisation agency, the agency said on Wednesday.
After the privatisation process, the capital of Ventspils Nafat will rise from 30 million lats to around 200 million lats and the state will be left with 26 percent of the shares.

Legal director Viktor Shadinov told Reuters that the four stages involve the sale of the state's 90 stake in Lasam, the merger of Lasam with Ventspils Nafta, the sale of shares in the merged Lasam/Ventspils Nafta in quotas and the fourth stage is the sale of seven percent of Ventspils to Lasam shareholders.

Shadinov said that 15.5 percent would be sold in the public offer, five percent for cash, seven percent will be placed abroad and two percent will be placed with state-owned Savings Bank as part of its restructuring process.
He also said 0.75 percent will be distributed between employees and 0.75 percent to the current management.

The sale of the seven percent in the fourth stage will be carried out according to the price of Ventspils shares on the stock exchange at a price which is registered a month before the signing of the purchase deal.
